points: Worked in an agile team of five on the questionnaire engine of a live Australian digital mental health platform (Nest.js / PostgreSQL / React Native).
Made scoring configurable at runtime: custom categories, severity thresholds, weighting with auto-redistribution, and reverse scoring.
Extended the new scoring logic into the clinician dashboard and PDF export report.
Stood up the full multiservice stack locally, and traced a data mismatch that produced no error and no log entry.
Delivered a 100% UAT pass rate across two client signed iterations.
Major in Software Development, minor in Games Development.
Built game prototypes in Unreal Engine and Unity (C++, C#) covering gameplay mechanics, AI systems and AR/VR experiences.
Created and textured 3D character models in Maya and Substance Painter with topology optimised for realtime rendering.
Built full stack web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js and PHP (CakePHP), and designed and tuned PostgreSQL databases.
Prototyped software and game concepts in 24 to 48 hour sprints using Agile.
Shipped a working demo at the end of each one.
Programmed robot navigation and sensor systems in Python and C++.
Collaborated on autonomous component design and presented technical updates to mentors.
